sample.problem: the fruit is hot . the door of the house is closed . the bread is not hot . the fruit is at the school . the door of the school is locked . the fish is at the school . the water is not hot . the water is at the shop . the bread is at the house . the person is at the field . the person wants a hot thing . plan :
sample.plan: the person wants the fruit because the fruit is hot . the door of the school is locked , so the person needs the key . the person is not at the shop , so the person goes to the shop . the person takes the key .
